findings.description: First workflow limited push branch/path but workflow_dispatch could run another same-repository ref because job.if only checked the repository.

The source-lock JSON itself is checked against a workflow literal at startup and recorded, but not rehashed at pipeline end. All locked source payloads and public inputs are rehashed at the end. Changing only that lock later does not change this already loaded computation or create a clearance false pass. This is not an OS-enforced immutability claim.
